description: This file contains AI attack analysis functions for the Battle for Wesnoth game, including attack simulations, weapon selection, and target evaluation.

classes.name: attack_type
classes.description: Represents an attack type with properties like backstab and slow.

classes.name: attack_analysis
classes.description: Holds data and methods for analyzing attack scenarios, including evaluation and rating.

classes.name: battle_type
classes.description: Represents a specific battle scenario with attacker, defender, terrain, and weapon.

methods.name: ai::do_attack_analysis
methods.description: Performs recursive analysis of attack possibilities on a location.

methods.name: ai::choose_weapon
methods.description: Selects the best weapon for a unit to attack a target based on simulated battle stats.

methods.name: ai::attack_analysis::analyze
methods.description: Simulates multiple attack scenarios to evaluate potential outcomes.

methods.name: ai::attack_analysis::rating
methods.description: Calculates a score for an attack scenario based on various tactical factors.

methods.name: ai::analyze_targets
methods.description: Analyzes potential attack targets for AI units and evaluates their threat levels.

methods.name: ai::power_projection
methods.description: Assesses the strength of units in adjacent tiles to a location.
